Method of Attack: The vulnerability may be exploited using a maliciously crafted .webp lossless file, which causes the vulnerable library to overflow. Attacks against this vulnerability can range from denial of service (DoS) to possible remote code execution (RCE).
Discoverer: Apple Security Engineering and Architecture (SEA) and The Citizen Lab at The University of Toronto's Munk School
Impacted Systems: operating systems and popular application frameworks that render .webp images
